# Company Intelligence Finder: B2B Enrichment, ICP Search & Lookalikes

Turn a domain, work email, company name or public profile URL into one merged company record. Search for companies that match a target-customer profile, discover lookalikes with an explainable similarity score, and list recent company registrations — all from public, cookieless sources with no API keys.

## What this actor does

- **Enrich** — resolve domains, work emails, company names, and LinkedIn/Crunchbase/ZoomInfo/Wikipedia URLs to a company, then merge every public source into one record.
- **ICP search** — filter by country, region, city, industry keywords, NAICS/SIC codes, employee range, founding years, public/private status, legal form, technology, active hiring and recent SEC Form D funding. Every record carries the source total and returned count.
- **Lookalikes** — seed with company domains; candidates come from LinkedIn public similar pages and matching registry searches. Each result gets a 0–100 similarity score with reasons (industry, size, country, technology, founding year, keywords).
- **New companies** — recent registrations from GLEIF, Companies House, Brønnøysundregistrene, and France's company search (via GLEIF when the national API has no date filter).

## Data sources (all public, no login)

| Area | Source |
|---|---|
| Website | schema.org JSON-LD, Open Graph/meta tags, contact/about pages, footer links, mailto/tel links |
| LinkedIn | Public company page: industry, size, HQ, type, specialties, followers, similar pages |
| Knowledge graph | Wikidata entity data and Wikipedia summaries |
| Global registry | GLEIF LEI records, direct/ultimate parent relationships |
| National registries | Companies House (UK), Brønnøysundregistrene (NO), recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr (FR) |
| US filings | SEC EDGAR submissions, XBRL company facts, full-text search and Form D XML |
| DNS | Google DNS-over-HTTPS MX/SPF/TXT records |
| Domain age | RDAP registration events |
| Hiring | Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Teamtailor, Breezy, Personio, ApplyToJob detection and job counts |
| News | Google News RSS |

LinkedIn and other HTML pages are requested with browser TLS impersonation. If a page rejects the first request, the actor retries through Apify's automatic proxy. No cookies or credentials are used.

## Modes and examples

### Enrich

```json
{
  "mode": "enrich",
  "domains": ["stripe.com", "siemens.com"],
  "emails": ["sales@example-company.com"],
  "companyNames": ["Microsoft"],
  "companyUrls": ["https://www.linkedin.com/company/microsoft/"],
  "includeFunding": true,
  "includeNews": true,
  "maxItems": 5
}
```

### ICP search

```json
{
  "mode": "icpSearch",
  "country": "United Kingdom",
  "industryKeywords": ["software"],
  "sicCodes": ["62020"],
  "employeeMin": 11,
  "employeeMax": 200,
  "foundedYearMin": 2015,
  "maxItems": 20
}
```

### Lookalikes

```json
{
  "mode": "lookalike",
  "seedDomains": ["stripe.com"],
  "country": "United States",
  "minSimilarity": 55,
  "maxItems": 10
}
```

### New companies

```json
{
  "mode": "newCompanies",
  "country": "Norway",
  "registeredWithinDays": 30,
  "maxItems": 20
}
```

## Output per company

- **Identity:** legal name, brand name, domain, website, logo, description, company type, legal form, status
- **Industry:** industry, industries, NAICS/SIC/NAF codes, keywords, specialties
- **Size and age:** employee count, employee band, founded year, registration date
- **Location:** HQ address and parts, other offices, phone, generic company emails
- **Social:** LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, GitHub, Crunchbase, Wikipedia, Wikidata ID
- **Registry:** LEI, CIK, company number, VAT/tax/DUNS IDs, registry URL and sources
- **Ownership and markets:** parent and ultimate parent, subsidiaries, ticker, exchange, revenue
- **Funding:** total Form D amount sold, latest funding date, round details
- **Technology:** detected technologies, MX email provider, TXT-verified marketing tools
- **Domain:** creation date, age in days, registrar
- **Hiring:** ATS, open jobs count, careers URL
- **News and filings:** recent news items and latest SEC filings
- **Provenance:** `fieldSources` maps each field to its source URL; `sourceUrls` lists every source used
- **Search metadata:** `sourceTotal`, `resultCount`, `searchSources`
- **Lookalikes:** `similarity` (0–100), `similarityReasons`, `matchedSeed`

Every field is omitted when no public source publishes it. The actor never fills gaps with guessed values.

| `registeredWithinDays` | new | Lookback window |
| `includeWebsite`, `includeLinkedIn`, `includeWikidata`, `includeRegistry`, `includeSec`, `includeDns`, `includeTech`, `includeHiring`, `includeFunding`, `includeNews`, `includeOwnership` | all | Source toggles |
| `maxItems` | all | 1–1000 |

## Use cases

- **Sales prospecting:** build an ICP list with employee, geography and technology filters, then expand from a best customer.
- **Account enrichment:** standardise CRM rows from a domain or work email.
- **Market mapping:** compare industry and size distributions across countries.
- **Partner and competitor discovery:** find companies that look like a seed.
- **Startup monitoring:** follow new registrations and recently funded companies.

## Limitations and honest gaps

- **Private-company employee counts** are only available where a source publishes them (LinkedIn size band, Wikidata, national registries, SEC). Otherwise the field is omitted.
- **Company emails** are limited to role addresses published on the company site; personal emails are not guessed or generated.
- **France recent registrations** use GLEIF because the public company-search API does not expose a creation-date filter. French ICP filters are applied after retrieval.
- **LinkedIn** is a public guest page, not a full profile API. Some companies hide size, HQ or specialties; those fields are then omitted.
- **Revenue** comes from SEC XBRL or Wikidata and is not available for most private companies.
- **Form D funding** reflects amounts sold in SEC filings, not every private round.
- **Technology and ATS detection** are best-effort fingerprints from public HTML and DNS records.
- **Technology, hiring and funding ICP filters** need the corresponding source to be discoverable. Registry-only rows without a website, ATS or Form D filing cannot match those three filters and are skipped.

## FAQ

**Do I need a proxy or API key?** No. Every request is cookieless and key-free. Apify's automatic proxy is used only as a retry for an HTML page that blocks the first request.

**Why are some fields empty?** The actor omits anything no public source publishes. It never fabricates names, emails, phone numbers or financials.

**What does the similarity score mean?** It is a transparent rubric: industry up to 40 points, employee-band similarity up to 20, same country 15, shared technologies up to 10, founding-year proximity up to 5, and shared keywords up to 10.

**How fresh is registry data?** GLEIF publishes daily; Companies House and Brønnøysundregistrene update continuously; SEC EDGAR updates on filing; Wikidata and Wikipedia change continuously.

**Can I schedule it?** Yes. For monitoring, run `newCompanies` daily and use `registeredWithinDays` slightly above the schedule interval so no registration is missed.
